functions.name: freq_sink_c_impl::freq_sink_c_impl
functions.signature:
freq_sink_c_impl::freq_sink_c_impl(int fftsize,
                                   int wintype,
                                   double fc,
                                   double bw,
                                   const std::string& name,
                                   int nconnections,
                                   QWidget* parent): sync_block("freq_sink_c",
                 io_signature::make(0, nconnections, sizeof(gr_complex)),
                 io_signature::make(0, 0, 0)),
      d_fftsize(fftsize),
      d_fft_shift(fftsize),
      d_fftavg(1.0),
      d_wintype((fft::window::win_type)(wintype & 0xFF)),
      d_window_normalize(wintype & (1 << 15)),
      d_center_freq(fc),
      d_bandwidth(bw),
      d_name(name),
      d_nconnections(nconnections),
      d_port(pmt::mp("freq")),
      d_port_bw(pmt::mp("bw")),
      d_parent(parent)
